in_hindi.meaning: सूक्ष्म बुद्धिवादी, विघ्न द्वारा पहुँचे बिन्दु को समझने वाला

in_telugu.name: మనోమై
in_telugu.long_meaning: Manas (చిత్త, mind) + Maya (మెయె, illusion or magic)

in_marathi.name: Manomay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mind, Intellect, Sense
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manomay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manomay refers to one whose mind is immersed in the divine. It is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘manas’ meaning mind and ‘mayah’ meaning illusion or intellect. In Hindu mythology, Manomay is a term used to describe beings who have the power to manipulate the mind, like the gods.
